description: Run an arbitrary GraphQL query (and optional variables) against the Hypertune edge endpoint. Power-user escape hatch for full control — each Hypertune project has its own generated schema, so this handles any flag shape, nested selections, inline enum literals, or variables the convenience tools can't express. The query root field is `root(context: ...)`.

query.description: A complete GraphQL query string, e.g. `query { root(context: {environment: "production"}) { myFlag } }`.

variables.description: Optional GraphQL variables object matching the query's declared variables.

name: hypertune_query
title: Run a raw GraphQL query
